speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Polyarticular onset) or Osteoid Osteoma.

Given the severe nocturnal pain awakening you from sleep, which is characteristic of osteoid osteoma, could you pinpoint the exact location of the pain (e.g., a specific spot in the bone) and describe any "relief" you feel after taking aspirin or taking a warm bath?
